name: application-profile-edit-form
title: Profile Edit Form
description: Settings-page profile form combining an avatar with a change-photo action, name/contact fields, and a save bar — a full page-section composition, distinct from application-form-row's single field.
useWhen: Building an account or settings page section where a user edits their name, photo, and contact details.
Showing an explicit unsaved-changes indicator so users know a save is pending.
You want the avatar, fields, and save actions composed as one section rather than assembled from individual form-row primitives.
avoidWhen: You only need a single field with a label and help text — use application-form-row instead.
The form doesn't need an avatar or photo upload — a plain field list may be simpler.
Changes save automatically per field — an explicit save bar would be redundant with autosave.
responsiveBehavior: The form has a fixed max width suited to a settings page column; the name fields collapse from a two-column grid to a single column on very narrow screens.
accessibility: Every field carries a real label associated via htmlFor/id.
The change-photo control is a real button, not a clickable image, so it has a clear accessible name.
The unsaved-changes indicator in variant 2 pairs a dot, a background tint, and text together, not color alone.

variants.title: Standard settings form
variants.description: Avatar with a change-photo action, name/email/bio fields, and an always-visible footer save bar.
accessibility: The avatar image carries descriptive alt text naming the person, not just 'avatar'.

variants.title: Standard settings form (Dark)
variants.description: Standard profile edit form adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Field borders and footer bar contrast must meet WCAG AA on dark backgrounds.

variants.title: Public profile with unsaved indicator
variants.description: Public-profile form with an 'Unsaved changes' header indicator that appears while isDirty is true, and a prefixed username field.
accessibility: The dirty field's border color change is paired with the header indicator, not used as the only signal of unsaved state.

variants.title: Public profile with unsaved indicator (Dark)
variants.description: Public-profile form with an unsaved-changes indicator, adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Unsaved-changes indicator and field border contrast must meet WCAG AA on dark backgrounds.
